Methodology

Fiscal terms sourced from primary law, production-sharing contracts, government gazettes, and regulatory filings. Each entry carries a reliability tier (A-D) based on source type and recency. Regime grades reflect coverage of 8 standard fiscal keys plus A-tier source validation.

Source Tiers

APrimary law, official government gazette, signed contract
BRegulatory agency publication, audited annual report
CIndustry publication, verified academic source
DSecondary source, news, unverified estimate
